### Radical-cure treatment by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Radical-cure treatment policy | Treatment implementation | Implementation details | Health-system level | Health-system details | Implementation year | Additional safety recommendations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal: no definition** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Implemented | Prior to 2022/2023, 14 day low dose PQ implemented without G6PD testing for a long time in Bhutan | Up to the health centre level | Up to the health centre level | 2023 | Close medical supervision and patient counselling |
| **G6PD intermediate: no definition** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Implemented | Prior to 2022/2023, 14 day low dose PQ implemented without G6PD testing for a long time in Bhutan | Up to the health centre level | Up to the health centre level | 2023 | Close medical supervision and patient counselling |
| **G6PD deficient: no definition** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Implemented | Prior to 2022/2023, 14 day low dose PQ implemented without G6PD testing for a long time in Bhutan | Up to the health centre level | Up to the health centre level | 2023 | Close medical supervision and patient counselling |
| **If no testing available** | Based on risk-benefit assessment | Implemented | Prior to 2022/2023, 14 day low dose PQ implemented without G6PD testing for a long time in Bhutan | Up to the health centre level | Up to the health centre level | 2023 | Close medical supervision and patient counselling |
:::

### Radical-cure follow-up by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Follow-up approach | Follow-up implementation | Follow-up implementation year |
|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal: no definition** | DOT by health centre, all vivax cases are admitted in hospital for 3 days for treatment and monitoring - blood slides taken on day 1,2, 7, 28, 3 months, and one year | Implemented | 2013 |
| **G6PD intermediate: no definition** | DOT by health centre, all vivax cases are admitted in hospital for 3 days for treatment and monitoring - blood slides taken on day 1,2, 7, 28, 3 months, and one year | Implemented | 2013 |
| **G6PD deficient: no definition** | DOT by health centre, all vivax cases are admitted in hospital for 3 days for treatment and monitoring - blood slides taken on day 1,2, 7, 28, 3 months, and one year | Implemented | 2013 |
| **If no testing available** | DOT by health centre, all vivax cases are admitted in hospital for 3 days for treatment and monitoring - blood slides taken on day 1,2, 7, 28, 3 months, and one year | Implemented | 2013 |
:::

### Country-specific policy context
